transcript: So the reason why I ranked this the way it is, I think technology has done a lot of good but it's also done a lot of bad and I think if we somehow can revert back to just low tech and just have a smaller scale of what that is, I think that would just be for the greater good of humanity. Two, I ranked Religious Utopia second because I'm big in faith and I believe that Jesus is Lord and that He's died on the cross to save us and that through Him we can get eternal life. So that's just a big part of my life. But jumping down to six and seven, I think the AI-centered utopia was a little bit too much. I think AI has done a lot of good, but to have it make the decisions for us, I think we lose a lot of our free will in doing that.
